claims.text: The span detector uses a multi-turn answer module and defines its state at each time step based on previous states and memory.
The initial state of the span detector is a summary of the memory generated from the input passages and questions.
The architecture includes a BiLSTM that processes concatenated representations of questions and passages to form the final memory.
